candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits the caller's balance, so deposits no longer increase balances.
Replace the additive update with an assignment so the balance is set to msg.value instead of incremented.
Credit one extra wei per deposit by changing the added amount from msg.value to msg.value + 1.
Delete the statement 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum can modify MinSum even after initialization, changing the final value of MinSum.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so MinSum stays at its initial value after SetMinSum is called.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so SetMinSum always sets MinSum to zero.
Remove the assignment so the LogFile address never changes, leaving Log at its original value even after SetLogFile is called.
Assign LogFile(msg.sender) instead of LogFile(_log), so the logger becomes the caller's address rather than the supplied address.
Assign LogFile(address(this)) instead of LogFile(_log), pointing the logger at the contract itself.
Remove the initialization guard so SetLogFile can be called after Initialized(), allowing the LogFile address to change when it previously would revert.
Change the balance credit from `+= msg.value` to `= msg.value`, discarding any existing balance.
Change the balance credit to a debit (`-=`) so deposits subtract msg.value, underflowing and reverting.
Credit a fixed 1 wei instead of msg.value so the recorded balance no longer reflects the deposited amount.
Invert the require condition so deposits always revert.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call so the deposit is no longer recorded in the log history.
